primary_purpose: Exercise evidence scoring and explicit tool contracts; identify annotation and retrieval diagnostics before human review.
tool_contract_limit: Exact/read arguments are prescribed by fixtures, not selected by an Agent. No claim about Agent routing or general exhaustive-match scalability.
error_policy: Retain errors and denominators; undefined evidence/ranking remains null; no retries.
order: Dataset order; rotate ranking methods by case position; after P0 finishes to avoid concurrent inference.
comparisons: Exploratory paired family bootstrap of evidence coverage for complete comparable cases; no release or superiority conclusion.
timing: Single-run uncontrolled cache/load; no warm/cold or production latency claim.
